_note: ED-00, ED-02, ED-05, ED-07a, ED-07b. The level editor's own tuning numbers. limits: caps the validator enforces on a level file (prims, placed Foamers, triggers, props, level size in metres, sky image width and height in pixels, a stairs box's most steps), so a level over one does not load. grid: metres a position or a size snaps to. rotateStep: degrees a rotation snaps to. palette: the nine colours the inspector offers. sky: a new level's sky. triggerDefaults: the play-time defaults the level file may omit. keys: key pickups and key doors in play (collectRadius: metres from the feet a key is taken; doorReach: metres from a key door's centre at which the held key opens it; size: the key's length; colours: the key and its door, used by the editor's markers too). markers: how each kind of placed thing is drawn in the editor and the colour a pickup takes when the level file says nothing. arena: the Arena button's numbers (holdSeconds: seconds between the Foamers of one wave arriving at their spawn points in turn; defaultCount: the count a new wave starts with). start: the loadout a new level starts with, in data/blasters.json and data/melee.json ids. camera: the editor camera (flySpeed and fastSpeed: metres a second with WASD while right mouse is held, fastSpeed with Shift; lookSpeed and orbitSpeed: radians a pixel of mouse; zoomStep: share of the distance to the point under the cursor one wheel notch covers; minDistance: metres the wheel stops short of that point; fallbackDistance: metres ahead used when the cursor is over empty sky; handleSize: the move, rotate and scale handles' size, 1 is three.js's own; openBack and openUp: metres behind and above the player start the camera sits when a level opens; faceHandleSize: the size of a resize handle on a face, as a share of its distance from the camera, so it looks the same size near and far). assets: ED-23's saved assets (max: how many this browser keeps; maxThings: how many things one asset may hold; pictureSize: the side of an asset's picture in pixels).

lights._note: ED-32: at most this many lights cast shadows (each is a shadow map pass). referenceRange: a light's output grows with its range squared relative to this many metres, so range sets how far it spreads (at this range a light is as bright as its intensity says).

models._note: ED-35: an imported GLB may be this many bytes, and all of a level's together this many (they live inside the level file). A voxel breakable model with more voxels inside than maxVoxels is built by hit points instead.

terrain._note: ED-34: maxCells: the most heightfield cells along a side. defaultSize, defaultCell and baseY: the flat terrain the Terrain tool makes, in metres (baseY a little over the new level's floor top at 0, so the two do not flicker). headroom: metres of open sky over the terrain's highest point that still count as inside the level. layers: its four paint layers (a surface from data/surfaces.json and a colour). brush: the brush's starting radius (m) and strength, and the sliders' top ends.

paint._note: The Paint tool's own brush on the terrain: its starting size (m) and strength (a share a second, so a quick pass covers), and the sliders' top ends.

_nudgeNote: The arrow keys nudge the selection one grid step, or nudgeFine metres with snap off.

textures._note: R3-04: caps for uploaded textures. maxCount: how many uploads a level may hold. maxSize: the side in pixels a side may be, after scaling down. maxBytes: the approximate size of one data: URL (a base64 image is three quarters its length).
